selection_contract.selection_rule: No exact ODL-07 integration vocabulary or mechanics are implementation-authorized until a future governed start resolves them from current canonical Business/Economy, Base/Vehicle, Settlement/World, Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character/crew/family, Project/time, DPL/WCI, Permission/visibility and SCL planning authority.
selection_contract.advisory_rule: ODL-01..06 outputs remain read-only/descriptive/advisory and cannot automatically create ODL-07 integration state or SCL outcomes.
selection_contract.visibility_rule: Hidden/private business, base, settlement, faction, crew, family, relationship, leadership, resource, Project, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence must be filtered before all derived output and hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
selection_contract.mutation_rule: No business/base/settlement/faction/crew/family owner mutation, relationship/reputation/leadership/resource/Project/time mutation, command/action/system permission, SCL implementation or canonical write is selected.
selection_contract.persistence_decision: unresolved until governed start; migration 0022 remains unreserved
